answer: Every claim climbs the cipher of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the dawn re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The prism of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, revoked by a single upheld challenge, no identity may audit its own recruit. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
